description: Website audit: uptime, SSL, security headers, domain age in one call. One call to audit a website: url_check (status, redirects, speed), ssl_check (certificate, expiry), security_headers (A-F grade), rdap_domain (registration and expiry dates, so domain age) and robots_check. Each part is returned under its tool name. Price: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: check_website
